notes: Merged from two passes that agree on the eight shared requirements (case 1233 with its group 18 and state in_progress, interaction 1233, contract 154, entitlement 432, case_sla 2465 on definition 6, case_knowledge 528 on article 210) and on all twelve dispositions. disagreement: kind of the assignment and state requirements: A create, B change; kept change because the cells are set by later tool calls on the created row (logged in the requirements). disagreement: interaction cells: A omits contact_id, B includes contact_id = 10; kept B's as the tighter predicate (logged in the requirement). disagreement: A's stay that retired article 195 is not linked to case 1233 (B had none); kept because the policy forbids linking an unpublished article. disagreement: B's stay that case 1233 does not take installed products 2 or 108 (A had none); dropped because the create requirement pins installed_product_id = 42 on the same row, a single-valued column, so the stay cannot fail unless the create already fails. disagreement: B's stay that contract 138 stays expired (A had none); dropped because the request asks for a new contract and neither it nor the policy forbids touching 138, which makes it a generic invariant measured as collateral (no tool updates contracts either). Rule update rather than a disagreement: both passes excluded the three timestamp-only checks on new rows (enlist_new_contract (2), add_new_entitlement (2), link_case_knowledge (2)); under the current rule they are repaired, since their other cell (the new row's id) is carried, and the contract and case requirements name them in source. The escalation flag is required by neither pass: the policy's escalation section is permissive and 'Escalation Management' names the group. The knowledge link rests on the benchmark's prior plus the policy's search rule; the request never says 'investigate'. The acting user Joanne Simpson (user 4) is a manager, so every step is within her role, and no benchmark check depends on the acting user. The interaction has no tool to write it. The prior contract the request mentions is 138 (warranty, expired 2025-05-14, with the inactive enterprise h24x7 entitlement 75).
